blocks.text: Yeh atmosphere ki sab se neeche wali layer hai jo 12 km tak jati hai. Atmosphere ki sab major gases, jaise nitrogen, oxygen aur carbon dioxide, isi mein hain. Is layer mein temperature 17 °C se -58 °C tak barabar kam hota jata hai. Yeh sab se densest (ghani) layer hai. Barish, bijli (lightning) aur toofan (hurricanes) jaise bare mausam ke events isi layer mein hote hain.

blocks.alt: Neeche daen zameen ka gol hissa aur oopar neela aasman. Zameen ke qareeb se ek lambi tirchhi lakeer oopar jati hai jise chaar label wali lakeerein kaatti hain jo oonchai ko layer ke naam se jorti hain: 0-12 km Troposphere, 12-50 km Stratosphere, 50-85 km Mesosphere aur 85-600 km Thermosphere.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.1: Atmosphere ki layers (kitab ki Figure 14.1 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche se oopar chaar layers hain: troposphere (0-12 km, mausam isi mein hota hai), stratosphere (12-50 km, ozone layer yahin hai), mesosphere (50-85 km, sab se thandi) aur thermosphere (85-600 km). Kitab ki figure mein mesosphere '50-80 km' aur thermosphere '80-600 km' likha hai, jabke kitab ka apna text 85 km kehta hai; hamari drawing mein text ke mutabiq 50-85 km aur 85-600 km likha hai.
